Four PNG masks extracted from assets/embedded_assets.hpp and embedded as base64 in electron/media/gemini-masks.cts. MIT license accompanies these assets.
Frame Studio uses only visible-logo reverse alpha blending, without AI denoise, SynthID removal, or external processing.
